categories.name: Chain Low% Sunken City
categories.rules:
A run ending with the player beating the game and exiting on 7-4 after collecting the Hedjet or Crown, Ankh, Excalibur or Scepter, Tablet of Destiny, and hatching the Qilin. This category imposes the following additional restrictions:

1) Increasing Health, Bombs, or Ropes. You can re-collect ropes that were part of your starting inventory.
2) Collecting any Item that adds an icon to the HUD, except for the Udjat Eye and Tablet of Destiny.
3) Wearing any Item.
4) Pressing the action/whip button while holding any Item listed in the Journal, except to drop it. This restriction does not apply to unloaded Bows and Crossbows, Idols, Curse Pots, Ushabtis, and Eggplants. It also does not apply to swinging the Excalibur in Abzu.
5) Picking up the Shield or Wooden Shield.
6) Curing permanent status effects.
7) Ride a tamed mount/mech, except for the Qilin in Tiamat's Throne.

categories.name: Low%
categories.rules: A run ending in the player beating the game with the following restrictions: 1) Increasing Health, Bombs, or Ropes. You can re-collect ropes that were part of your starting inventory. 2) Collecting any Item that adds an icon to the HUD. 3) Wearing any Item. 4) Pressing the action/whip button while holding any Item listed in the Journal, except to drop it. This restriction does not apply to Idols, Curse Pots, Ushabtis, and Eggplants. 5) Picking up the Shield or Wooden Shield. 6) Curing permanent status effects. 7) Ride a tamed mount/mech.

categories.name: All Shortcuts + Tiamat
categories.rules: The player has to unlock all of the Terra shortcuts and complete the game by defeating Tiamat. The timer begins with the player character entering the door to 1-1 and stops when the player reappears in the transition screen after exiting Tiamat's lair.

categories.name: No Teleporter Any%
categories.rules: A run ending with the player completing the game. Teleporting by any means is forbidden.

categories.name: No Teleporter Sunken City%
categories.rules: A run ending with the player beating the game and exiting on 7-4. Teleporting by any means is forbidden.

categories.name: Sunken City% Abzu
categories.rules: A run ending with the player beating the game and exiting on 7-4 after collecting the Hedjet or Crown, Ankh, Excalibur, Tablet of Destiny, and hatching the Qilin.

categories.name: No Gold
categories.rules: The player has to complete the game having never had a score of more than $0 by the time of completion.

categories.name: No Gold Sunken City%
categories.rules: A run ending with the player beating the game and exiting on 7-4 having never had a score of more than $0 by the time of completion. Teleporting and All Skips allowed.

categories.name: No Gold Low%
categories.rules: A run ending with the win criteria of both the Low% speedrun and the No Gold speedrun combined.

categories.name: Eggplant%
categories.rules: A run ending with the player beating the game and exiting on 7-4 with the eggplant crown.
